exact_candidate.runtime_grant_order: One ordinary opportunity after ADC/TIME/stable before RX/prepare, with a fresh TIME/stable barrier; the former wrapper opportunity is only an early-return fallback. No second opportunity per runtime step.
exact_candidate.warning: These constants describe the reviewed image, not authenticated physical identity.

metric_meaning.driver_observed_poll_gap_us: Maximum observed driver stamp minus previous service timestamp; not the latest timestamp or a WCET bound.
metric_meaning.copy_max_us: Maximum observed read/copy validation interval; not an ADC conversion or only memcpy duration.
metric_meaning.poll_gap_max_cycles: Maximum interval between DWT poll instrumentation points; can include TX preparation and differs from TIM2 service timestamps.
metric_meaning.step_body_max_cycles: Runtime step bracket still includes prepare/encode; not a measured CPU-only or IRQ-off duration.
metric_meaning.step_gap_max_cycles: Maximum begin-step stamp spacing; includes prepare/encode, inter-step work and interrupts, not only step body.
metric_meaning.tx_max_cycles: V2SB bracket starts AFTER prepare/encode and covers guarded submit through unlock. Preparation is excluded; do not directly compare against S8/S9 TX maxima. This is not an exact IRQ-off duration or qualified transaction bound.
metric_meaning.queue_high_water: Maximum observed DATA128 queue use out of 8; no proof of zero ADC loss.
metric_meaning.start_cycle_last_cycle_freeze_cycle: Raw DWT modulo2^32 values; cannot directly subtract for sessions longer than one cycle-counter wrap.
metric_meaning.first_runtime_result_0xffffffff: Sentinel: cause observed before a runtime return; see first fault fields.

nominal_cycles_to_us.qualification: Arithmetic only; assumes72MHz, uninterrupted DWT and intervals shorter than one2^32-cycle wrap (~59.65s).

minimal_stopped_register_checks.TIM3_CR1_0x40000400: CEN bit0 must be0; driver normally writes whole register0.
minimal_stopped_register_checks.DMA1_CH1_CCR_0x40020008: EN bit0 must be0; remaining configuration normally0x25a0.
minimal_stopped_register_checks.RCC_AHBENR_0x40021014: DMA1 enable bit0 must remain1 for meaningful readback.
minimal_stopped_register_checks.RCC_APB2ENR_0x40021018: GPIOA bit2 and ADC1 bit9 must remain1.

limits: Local dumps and expected values do not prove flashed image identity.
HOST END/STOP_ACK and actual USB delivery require separate evidence.
Cycles are modulo uint32; no elapsed-time or calibrated clock inference.
Debugger halt and intervals below one cycle-counter wrap are external assumptions.
TX bracket excludes prepare/encode in V2SB; its boundary differs from S8/S9. Runtime step and poll spacing still include preparation. It is not the qualified transaction or exact IRQ-off duration.
The separate S9 512-byte active-phase profile is disabled in this image; this decoder reads only legacy136.
V2SB relocates one grant earlier; this ABI does not timestamp final-IN to task/publication or prove improved USB throughput.
A record with warnings remains evidence of a failed or limited observation.
